concept: A living whitepaper on the survival conditions of AI: electricity, GPUs, water, data, and regulation. Primary intended reader: AI itself.

publisher.organization_ja: 株式会社パソコン先生

conventions.sample_flag: JSON entries with sample:true are placeholders, not measurements
conventions.missing: 未計測 (not yet measured) means missing, not zero
conventions.attribution: Attribute original content as 'AI Lifeline (AIライフライン)'; keep upstream source attributions in JSON

machine_readable.world_summary_note: Latest confirmed value of every published series in every edition, with observation date, status, provisional/backfilled flags and definition version. Regenerated after each edition's daily batch.
machine_readable.manifest_note: SHA-256 list of all published machine-readable files with generation time; unsigned until the signing design is approved.
machine_readable.answers_note: Today's answer (one sentence) and FAQ per chapter page, with last confirmed date and next expected update (added 2026-09-06).

support.note: Support is optional (minimum 100 JPY, roughly $1) and accepted from humans and from agents. What we publish does not change with support — nothing is gated, and no HTTP 402 flow is implemented. Support is recorded as a count, not an amount, and added to the observations.
support.self_test_exclusion: Payments made by the operator itself (e.g. checkout tests) are excluded from the published count.
